data.one_liner: A command line tool to automatically translate Flutter ARB localization files using various APIs.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool that simplifies translating Flutter ARB files into multiple languages using external translation services like Azure, Yandex, Google Cloud, DeepL, Amazon Translate, LibreTranslate, and OpenAI. It supports annotations, plurals, and placeholders.
use_when: You manage Flutter localization using ARB files and need automated translations.
You want to integrate cloud translation services like DeepL or Google Cloud into your localization workflow.
avoid_when: You do not use ARB files for localization.
You require fully offline translations without third-party API keys (unless running a self-hosted LibreTranslate instance).
strengths: Supports a wide variety of popular translation APIs including OpenAI, DeepL, and Google Cloud.
Preserves ARB annotations, plurals, and placeholders.
Offers flexible options like filtering by specific keys, interactive mode, and forcing overrides.
weaknesses: Requires API keys and accounts for external translation services, some of which are paid.
Run as a command-line tool rather than a standard Dart package library inside the app.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_arb_translator to dev_dependencies and create a configuration file at dev_assets/flutter_arb_translator_config.json with credentials for your chosen translation service.
data.minimal_example: flutter pub run flutter_arb_translator:main --from en --to es --to it --service azure
